sections.title: Value Proposition
bullets: Card-Social redefines contact management and data communication, evolving the static concept of traditional cards into a dynamic, secure ecosystem.

Dynamic evolution (“You change, your card changes”): Removes contact-data obsolescence. As users advance professionally or personally (e.g., transitioning from university to a corporate career), their card updates instantly. Every contact keeps access to the latest version of the information the user chooses to share—enabling lifelong connections.

"The Vault" (data vault): A centralized, highly secure storage system where users keep emails, phones, and social links. Data is visually masked through “IconoDatas” at sharing time, protecting raw information until the recipient interacts with it.

Smart Cards (secure, controlled interaction): Built for in-person contact. Each card can group up to 12 IconoDatas. The competitive edge is privacy: a temporary QR code that expires in two minutes—information is delivered only to the person in front of you, deterring improper data harvesting.

Business Cards (expansive commercial presence): Built for scale. A permanent QR suited for flyers, stickers, and signage—with logos, invisible map locations, up to 20 niche keywords, and editable contact name or tagline—while protecting the holder’s face and personal identity.

Corporate sync (shared vaults): A hierarchy where an entire team uses a unified token. Company information (promotions, catalogs, PDFs, policies) lives in a non-public corporate vault so every sales rep shares the latest, authorized information.

sections.title: Customer Segments
bullets: Casual user (Free Tier): Individuals without a commercial promotion focus—social, academic, and work circles organized with fluid sharing of basic profiles without sacrificing privacy or cluttering contacts.
Entrepreneur / Creator (Influencer Tier): Growing professionals and creators promoting a niche, product, or service—needs digital presence metrics and scalable subscriber/customer acquisition.
Enterprise (Corporate Tier): Large organizations (e.g., master-planned developers such as Ciudad Maderas) with broad sales teams or departments needing hierarchical communications (HR, leadership).

establishedExamples.text: One card for dine-in menus and table payments, another for the bar, a third for catering, and a fourth for special events.
Differentiated cards for open houses, property models, customer service, and aggressive marketing campaigns.

tiers.name: Free Tier
tiers.detail: 1 user · 8 IconoDatas · 5 Smart Cards · 0 Business Cards.

tiers.name: Influencer Tier
tiers.detail: 1 user · 10 IconoDatas · 10 Smart Cards · 1 Business Card.

tiers.name: Business Tier
tiers.detail: 3 users · 50 IconoDatas · 10 Smart Cards · 5 Business Cards.

tiers.name: Corporate Tier
tiers.detail: Direct B2B sales · multiple users on one token · corporate vaults with tiered permissions and institutional rollout.

items: In-person interaction via short-lived on-screen QR scans (Smart Cards).
Printed touchpoints—stickers, menus, signage—with permanent QR (Business Cards).
Digital distribution of links and profiles on social media.
Direct enterprise sales for the corporate ecosystem.
Trust and strict privacy: Users fully control who, how, and when personal or business data is accessed.
Transitional support: The platform earns long-term loyalty by adapting to life stages or pivots—users never lose the network they built.
Cryptographic maintenance and security for The Vault and personal data.
Dynamic QR generation with precise latency (two-minute expiry).
Server architecture for keyword search and invisible geolocation.
Hierarchical access control for corporate accounts.
Technology for individual and shared vaults (access tokens).
UI platform for agile card and data assignment.
Enterprise sales leadership integrating the Corporate Tier.
Marketing agencies and event organizers driving early Influencer and Business adoption.
Continuous web and mobile application development.
Operational costs for encryption and hierarchical token infrastructure.

flows.queEs: A premium physical card shipped to the user’s address, linked to the account with a security code.
flows.comoFunciona: The user taps NFC on the recipient’s phone and data transfers instantly. Inside the app, the NFC menu picks—live—which digital card (personal, business, influencer) is shared on tap.
valorEstrategico: Unmatched tactile and visual prestige in face-to-face meetings.
Removes all friction from sharing information.
flows.modeloIngreso: Direct hardware sale (one-time purchase) plus shipping.

flows.queEs: App-to-app voice calls, represented by a dedicated generic IconoData for this feature.
flows.comoFunciona: Place and receive calls with new contacts without ever exposing the real phone number.
valorEstrategico: Ultimate privacy shield—personal numbers never land in third-party databases.
Communications stay inside the Card-Social ecosystem.
flows.modeloIngreso: High-value retention driver that makes paid subscriptions more attractive.

flows.queEs: A hyper-local search engine at the root of the app connecting needs with services—without relying on social algorithms or paid ads.
flows.comoFunciona: Uses the 20 JSON keywords on Business Cards plus invisible GPS within a 25-mile radius. Golden rule: when searching for a service (e.g., “barber”), the user’s network is scanned first—friends or family offering that service appear first, then local proximity results.
valorEstrategico: Works for remote or nomadic work—update location and Social Market recalibrates the radius.
Lowers customer acquisition cost for small businesses.
flows.modeloIngreso: Core Business Tier hook—businesses pay not only for data organization but for visibility in this local search engine.

flows.queEs: In-app virtual store dedicated to the visual customization of cards.
flows.comoFunciona: Purchase icon packs, color palettes, design styles, and visual themes (skins) to change profile appearance.
valorEstrategico: Meets the psychological need for differentiation (personal and corporate branding).
Keeps the product visually fresh without redesigning core code.
flows.modeloIngreso: Microtransactions (in-app purchases)—scalable revenue beyond monthly subscription.

strategicBlocks.title: Market Radar (heatmap)
strategicBlocks.queEs: A premium geographic visualization and predictive intelligence tool based on local demand.
strategicBlocks.comoFunciona: The system collects anonymous Social Market searches and turns them into a dynamic heatmap. Businesses enter keywords and see which zip codes—inside their 25-mile radius—generate those searches.
valorBullets: Moves the platform from contact manager to market-intelligence product.
Points marketing, sales, and physical expansion toward real-time demand—reducing financial guesswork.
strategicBlocks.modeloIngreso: Premium upsell—paid add-on to Business Tier, high B2B margin for exclusive market data.

strategicBlocks.title: Executive dashboard · Lost sales
strategicBlocks.queEs: Analytics console for Business Card users to measure profile performance in the local market.
strategicBlocks.comoFunciona: Captures interaction metrics—profile traffic, conversion (who saved the card), and local SEO positioning signals.
valorBullets: Makes subscription ROI tangible with reach data.
Introduces “lost sales” alerts when nearby consumers searched the user’s niche but the Business Card missed due to keyword gaps.
strategicBlocks.modeloIngreso: Ongoing incentive to optimize profiles and stay subscribed.

strategicBlocks.title: B2B sync · Ciudad Maderas case study
strategicBlocks.queEs: Hierarchical infrastructure syncing sales teams, agencies, or franchises under one controlling entity.
strategicBlocks.comoFunciona: Shared Enterprise vaults: a central admin uploads corporate assets. Example: at Ciudad Maderas, update plans, catalogs, or budgets for Aura, Alba, Nova, Stella, and Lucero models in the central vault—in seconds every advisor’s Smart and Business Cards receive the new version.
valorBullets: Fully homologated corporate information—no stale collateral or pricing in the field.
Digital asset control with access revocation without losing hard-won customers when someone leaves.
strategicBlocks.modeloIngreso: Enterprise SaaS contracts—higher volume and long-term retention.
